author: Yoshimitsu590
quote: For the price, I absolutely have the right to critique this game. I am absolutely unhappy with the pricing scheme, and I hope it doesn't set the precedent for modern gaming. This game is full of bugs. Plenty of collision issues, among other things. If GTA V's ragdoll system was a downgrade, this is even worse. It manages to have worse ragdoll system than RDR2 and V.
